name: Parallel Ray-Tracing for Isosurface Rendering
aliases: Parallel ray-tracing algorithm for isosurface rendering
definition: A parallel ray-tracing method for volume visualization that determines which object contributes to each pixel's final color, designed specifically for shared-memory architectures where previous object-space algorithms did not scale beyond 32 processors.
summary: Parallel Ray-Tracing for Isosurface Rendering is a parallel image-order algorithm that uses a multi-level min-max hierarchy and analytic cubic intersections to efficiently render isosurfaces from large volume datasets.
